construction.implementation_origin: Original isolated reference implementation built from the supplied requirements

input.schema: Nonempty list of exact {name, labels, type, required} objects; globally unique case-insensitive literal labels and unique identifier names

output.fields: Field-name map to {value, source_text, span:{start,end}} or null
output.missing_fields: List of {field,required}, including optional absent fields
output.error: On validation, JSON, file or usage failures: {status:error,message:string} only

shared_schema.validation: Single validate function for request structure and typed extracted values; JSON loader additionally rejects duplicate keys and nonstandard constants

cross_stage_handoffs: Single extraction stage: validated request -> literal labeled-line scan -> shared typed-value validation -> JSON report

behavior.matching: Case-insensitive whole literal labels at line start after optional indentation; colon or equals separator; label aliases supported
behavior.duplicates: First matching document line wins, even if blank or invalid
behavior.spans: Zero-based, end-exclusive Unicode code-point offsets into the unmodified document; leading and trailing value whitespace excluded
behavior.missing: Blank and absent values are reported; required missing values make status incomplete
behavior.invalid_values: Any invalid typed value makes status incomplete and preserves source evidence; invalid values are not also reported as missing
behavior.numbers: Signed integers or finite decimal floats, no currency, grouping or exponent notation; decimal numbers use binary float precision

exit_codes.2: Validation, JSON, file or usage error

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: one JSON object, status ok, optional purchase_order reported missing
